intro: The tongue emoji 😛 is the internet's shorthand for 'just kidding' — a lighthearted, teasing face that softens a joke or a playful jab. This page gathers the whole silly range: the winking 😜, the squinting 😝, the fully unhinged 🤪 zany face, and the 👅 tongue emoji on its own for licks, tastes, and cheeky reactions. When an emoji won't carry the exact vibe, classic tongue-out kaomoji like :P and (≧∇≦) paste anywhere plain text works. Grab a single face, or copy a ready-made combo set for playful chats, comments, and replies.
